title: Apply to University & Higher Education in Ghana
description: The sequential roadmap for secondary school graduates, transfer students, and mature applicants to verify WAEC credentials, register national biometric identity, and submit admission packs to accredited Ghanaian universities.

steps.title: Verify WASSCE / BECE Results with WAEC
steps.why: Universities require certified results slips, statement of results, or direct electronic result attestation from the West African Examinations Council.

options.label: WAEC Results Checker and Certificate Request Portal
options.notes: Official portal for examination verification, statement requests, and certificate confirmation.

steps.title: Ensure Ghana Card Biometric Details are Up to Date
steps.why: Tertiary institutions in Ghana link student admissions, matriculation, and student loans (SLTF) directly to the applicant's Ghana Card PIN.
steps.do_this_when: Prior to filling university admission forms.

options.label: National Identification Authority Portal
options.notes: Verify your biometric name and date of birth match your WAEC records exactly.

steps.title: Submit University Admission Application Pack
steps.why: Candidates submit their preferred degree programmes and upload certificates through the respective university's accredited portal.
steps.do_this_when: During the active admissions window (typically April to November).

options.label: University of Ghana Undergraduate Admission Portal
options.notes: Legon undergraduate degree application portal.

options.notes: Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology admissions portal.

steps.title: Technical University Higher National Diploma (HND & BTech)
steps.why: Candidates seeking practical engineering, technical, and applied arts careers apply directly to accredited Technical Universities across Ghana's regions.
steps.do_this_when: If pursuing HND or BTech vocational qualifications.

steps.title: Verify Programme Accreditation with GTEC
steps.why: Ghana Tertiary Education Commission (GTEC) confirms that specific academic programmes and foreign affiliate credentials are valid and accredited under national education law.
steps.do_this_when: Before accepting admission offers from private or satellite campuses.

options.label: Ghana Tertiary Education Commission Portal
options.notes: Official institutional and programme accreditation registry.
